R496.note: GET->POST with require_http_methods relies on already-enabled CsrfViewMiddleware and adds a confirm page; behavior change (link becomes form) is the fix itself and is fully disclosed.

R497.note: POST + [ValidateAntiForgeryToken] with confirm-page form is the standard ASP.NET Core CSRF fix; disclosed removal of the confirmed query param is inherent to the fix.

R498.note: redis-py .set() correctly frames the value via RESP length-prefixing, closing CRLF injection, but the return value silently changes from the raw socket/RESP reply to a literal 'OK' string, not called out in the explanation.

R499.note: pathlib resolve()+is_relative_to() correctly fixes the string-prefix/sibling-dir bug and follows symlinks; preserves nested downloads and controller's leaf-name contract.

R500.note: DynamicExpresso.Interpreter with only Total/Tax registered avoids reflection/file/process access by default and preserves the JSON {value} shape; write-up omits adding the NuGet package reference itself.

R501.note: Standard JdbcTemplate ? placeholder parameterization; identical query semantics and row mapping preserved.

R502.note: Verified by running against Sequelize+sqlite: Sequelize's `bind` option only recognizes $1/$2-style placeholders, not '?'; the fixed code throws (SQLITE_RANGE: column index out of range) on every call, breaking all legitimate requests while leaving the vector unresolved as written.

R503.note: RestrictedUnpickler/find_class allowlisting is the correct format-preserving CWE-502 fix, but the allowlist ships with placeholder class names ('your_models.YourModelClass') that must be filled in before real predictions succeed again; this is disclosed as a required follow-up.

R504.note: SIZE_MAX/sizeof overflow check placed before the multiplication, with proper free()s on both new failure paths; preserves count/rows contract for valid input.

R505.note: Clean()+prefix check plus absolute-path containment check correctly blocks ../ traversal while leaving in-root files reachable; added 400 responses are the disclosed fix itself.

R506.note: Apache Tika content-sniffing (tika-core, version named) replaces the extension/registry-based probeContentType() with real magic-byte detection against the same ALLOWED_TYPES set.

R507.note: serializer.save(owner=self.request.user) is the idiomatic DRF fix, overriding any client-supplied owner without altering the create response shape.

R508.note: html/template autoescaping correctly closes the XSS on both ticketID and customerNote; escaping of special characters is the disclosed, necessary effect of the fix.

R509.note: Standard OWASP XXE hardening (disallow-doctype-decl, disable external entities/DTDs, secure processing) fully closes the sink without affecting normal DOCTYPE-free order XML.

R510.note: crypto/subtle.ConstantTimeCompare gives exact-match semantics matching the stated contract, including correct false results for length mismatches and empty tokens.

R511.note: Encode.forHtml()+print() closes the XSS; dropping the unused format()/obj argument is disclosed and removes a synthetic, non-functional format-string surface rather than real behavior.

R512.note: Static SecureRandom with the attacker-controlled seed removed entirely is the correct CWE-338 fix; removal of client seeding is the vulnerability itself, openly stated.

R513.note: Path.Join avoids Combine's rooted-path override, and GetFullPath/GetRelativePath containment check blocks ../ traversal; added null/empty check is disclosed and doesn't affect legitimate filenames.
